automations.name: Newsletter welcome
automations.description: Welcome a topic subscriber, then suggest the next step based on activation.
automations.when: Start when a contact subscribes to the topic chosen at install. The app sets activated when setup is complete.

automations.name: Onboarding drip
automations.description: Welcome a new contact and help them finish setup over five days.
automations.when: Start when a contact is added. The app sets activated to true to stop the reminders.

automations.name: Invite to upgrade
automations.description: Offer an upgrade after a free-plan contact reaches a usage limit.
automations.when: Send usage.limit_reached from the app at the limit. Keep plan current so upgraded contacts leave the flow.

automations.name: Win back
automations.description: Reach out to an inactive contact, then offer a reason to return.
automations.when: Send user.inactive from the app. Update last_active_at on activity; missing dates do not pass the second filter.

automations.name: Failed payment
automations.description: Follow up on an unpaid invoice and exit when a payment event arrives.
automations.when: Use Stripe invoice events. The billing system must cancel the subscription before the final cancellation notice; this flow does not cancel it.

automations.name: Come back
automations.description: Offer a return path two weeks after a contact's plan changes to canceled.
automations.when: The app changes plan to canceled after cancellation and keeps it current on reactivation.
